trigger: Start of cooling season / if unit leaks
steps: Locate the PVC condensate drain line near the indoor air handler.
Attach a wet/dry vacuum to the outdoor end of the drain line and run it for 1-2 minutes.
Alternatively, pour a cup of distilled vinegar into the drain access point every few months.
Confirm water drips from the outdoor line end and check for the pan overflow switch.
